metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting air and somehow doomed 1 poor soul?! Valorant aim is cursed again
metadata.description:
Me: wildly clicking like a panic button
Enemy: probably questioning their entire life
How did that even register? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim cheats more than your brain, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim’s broken but your hype’s not!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
